project: VARDHANI HIGH-SPECIALIST R3 — GPT-5.6 SOL TEACHER / STUDENT-250 V2
purpose: Test whether causal abstention based on each specialist's recently completed economic outcomes can suppress nonstationary losing regimes. The health gate uses only outcomes whose exit timestamps are already in the past at each decision time.

predecessor_evidence.R3E: retired after all preregistered 2023 Q values failed; 2024 unopened
predecessor_evidence.R3F: retired after fast/slow score consensus remained negative in both 2023 halves; 2024 unopened
predecessor_evidence.permitted_design_learning: Increasing model-score consensus/selectivity did not solve economic nonstationarity. R3G changes the structural hypothesis to causal performance-based abstention, not threshold relaxation or sign inversion.

targets.entry: next genuine same-session minute open after signal timestamp

base_model.fit_frequency: once per evaluation month using only dates strictly before that month
base_model.event_threshold: unweighted 75th percentile of abs(y_h) in the 126-date training window
base_model.raw_side_score: sign*mu + T_h*sign*(P_up-P_down), sign=+1 CE and -1 PE
base_model.base_percentile: empirical percentile of evaluation raw side score against same specialist's 126-date training raw scores

online_health_gate.health_stream: For each Q and each specialist independently, use prior base candidates of that same specialist whose base_percentile >= Q and whose exit_timestamp <= current signal timestamp. These health observations are independent of whether a global trade was selected.
online_health_gate.activation: active only when trailing health mean > 0 AND trailing health profit factor > 1
online_health_gate.update_time: a candidate may enter health history only after its horizon exit timestamp has been reached

calibration.candidate_eligibility: raw_side_score > 0 AND base_percentile >= Q AND specialist health active immediately before the signal
calibration.selection_rule: Among Q values passing every economic gate, choose highest worst-half net3 mean, then highest overall net3 mean, then highest net5 mean, then stricter Q.
calibration.if_none_pass: Retire R3G and do not open 2024 for R3G. Preregister a distinct R3H before any R3H model output.

audit_2024.health_history_at_2024_start: may use completed causal base-candidate outcomes from authorized prior 2023 dates because they are historical at the 2024 decision time

option_gate.data: genuine 2024 full-chain NIFTY option candles from authorized Sep-Oct expiry weeks
